analyze.ai_caveat: These win rates come from a scripted AI; combo decks are a lower bound.
analyze.caption: average win rate against the 12 top meta decks ({games} games per matchup)
app.sub: Local assistant: deck rating, mulligan, opponent reads. Everything is computed on your own computer.
app.title: TavernLab
coach.empty: Run «Analyse» on the deck rating tab first.
coach.intro: Findings from the telemetry of your last deck analysis.
coach.note: Deltas are correlational estimates from simulations with a scripted AI.
deck.label: Your deck code (in game: Deck → Copy)
games.empty_hint: Play a ranked game, or import a Power.log you already have.
import.cfg_help: Hearthstone writes the detailed log only when this file exists. Copy the snippet, paste it into the file yourself and restart the client.
import.done: Imported games: {n}. Reviews are building in the background.
import.intro: Import a Power.log to reconstruct your games.
import.manual_only: TavernLab never creates or edits log.config for you — you paste it yourself.
import.need_path: Enter a path to a Power.log.
import.readonly: Live recommendations are off: TavernLab only reads log files, nothing leaves your computer.
inspector.no_alternatives: Nothing to offer here: no lethal line was found, and this build does not rank plays.
inspector.no_dwp: No ΔWP ranking: search_ok=0, and the win-probability model is not a play-ranking oracle.
inspector.none: No decision recorded at this ply — this is a state snapshot.
inspector.title: Decision
mull.hand_label: Your opening hand (start typing a name for suggestions)
opp.seen_label: Cards he has already played (separated by ;)
optimize.none: No clear improvements — the deck is tight.
replay.no_snapshots: No reconstructed states for this game.
replay.pick: Open a game from Games, or from its review.
replay.state_only: state only (no decision at this ply)
review.approx_note: This lethal line came from a bounded search: plausible, not proven.
review.legend_help: Only the labels below are published in this build. The rest stay greyed out until the gates they need are green.
review.lethal_not_checked: The lethal solver did not run on this ply — it has a search budget and runs twice per turn of yours, so this is “not checked”, not “nothing there”.
review.no_moments: No missed lethal and no ledger leak worth flagging.
review.no_wp: No win-probability points for this game.
review.not_ready: This game has no review yet. The analysis runs locally and takes a few seconds.
review.partial_note: The review is complete, but the lethal search hit its time budget part-way through — later turns were not checked for a missed lethal. Everything else below is whole. Re-analyse to try again.
review.pick: Pick a game on the Games tab to open its review.
review.search_off: search_ok=0 in this build: no play is ranked and no skill glyph is published.
review.wp_hatched: The whole line is hatched on purpose: it comes from the logistic model, not from a search.
settings.live_default_off: When it is on, the lethal overlay shows the full line.
settings.live_warn: Off by default. Post-game review is the default mode; live evaluation is opt-in and reads the log while a game is running.
settings.player_name_hint: Optional. Your side is read from the log itself (FRIENDLY/OPPOSING); fill this in only if an import picks the wrong side.
